function_v0.doc:
Export source attestations to `recipient_oracle` on an Axelar `destination_chain`.

`source` is the native attester; 1\xe2\x80\x934 canonical payloads of at most 684 bytes each
must be attested in this adapter's own namespace. Recipient is a raw 32-byte ID
converted using the configured destination format. Attestations are not consumed.

# Authorization and effects
Relayed mode: `payer` authorizes this call and transfer of positive `gas_amount`
fee-token base units. Gas service and gateway calls are atomic. No fee funds are
retained by the adapter; provider refund handling targets the payer.

SelfRelay requires zero gas and no payer authorization; gateway dispatch remains.
Solana destinations require their config PDA and one proof of at most 320 bytes.

# Errors
Unknown chains, malformed addresses/messages, unattested proofs, mode/fee mismatch,
configuration errors, and downstream provider/auth failures. Estimate gas externally;
there is no local quote formula.
function_v0.name: submit

function_v0.doc:
Register proofs from an exact gateway-approved GMP message; any relayer may call.

`source_chain` selects the map after ASCII lowercasing and is passed to the gateway
exactly; `source_address` is the authenticated remote
adapter in that route's address format. `message_id` and Keccak of `payload` are
passed with this receiving contract to gateway `validate_message`. Only approval
permits decoding and recording the payload's source application/proofs.
Solana routes admit exactly one proof of at most 320 bytes, as on export.

# Effects and errors
Approval consumption and storage are atomic; a malformed/bounded-message failure
rolls both back. Absent or expired tuples emit `OutputProven`; all renew TTL.
`UnknownChain`, invalid address, `NotApproved`, `Malformed`, `MessageLimit`, or
provider failures abort. Source names and addresses are not caller attestations.
function_v0.name: execute

function_v0.doc:
Renew proof TTL for each concatenated 128-byte tuple, plus instance/code TTL.

Permissionless; the common capped renewal policy applies. Empty input succeeds;
`Malformed` rejects partial tuples and `NotProven` rejects any missing proof.
All renewals roll back on failure. This call does not register new evidence.
Proofs expire 120,960 ledgers after their last renewal; an expired proof needs a
fresh authenticated delivery.
function_v0.name: maintain

function_v0.doc:
Check one authenticated proof tuple without renewing proof TTL.

`chain` is the source OIF chain ID; `oracle` is the authenticated remote adapter;
`application` is the source attester's raw ID; `hash` is Keccak of a canonical payload.
Returns `false` for unknown or expired tuples. Permissionless; maintains
instance/code TTL. Configuration or host archival failures abort.
function_v0.name: is_proven

function_v0.doc:
Lowercase Axelar name mapped to `chain_id`; `UnknownChain` if unmapped.

The Stellar counterpart of EVM `reverseChainIdMap`, returning the name itself.
Permissionless; maintains instance/code TTL but does not renew the reservation.
function_v0.name: chain_name

function_v0.doc:
Install immutable `config`, the mapping `owner` and the expected Stellar `network_id`.

Requires native gateway/gas-service/token contract addresses. `owner` may be any
account or contract; it can only add chain maps and transfer or renounce ownership.
Returns `Configuration` for a wrong network or `Address` for non-contract provider
addresses. Maintains instance/code TTL. The deployer must verify provider addresses
and the native token for this network. No chain is mapped at deployment.
function_v0.name: __constructor

function_v0.doc:
Set an immutable map from a canonical lowercase Axelar `name` to `chain_id` and `kind`.

The owner authorizes; the transaction's source account pays the rent for both
new entries. Names are 1\xe2\x80\x9320 bytes of a-z, 0-9 and '-';
each name and nonzero chain ID is mapped once and never changes; there is no count
limit. This privilege lets chains be added after an immutable deployment, as in the
EVM mapped oracles. It cannot touch funds, proofs or existing maps, but it decides
which Axelar name authenticates an unmapped OIF chain ID; orders should only
reference mapped chains. Emits `ChainMapConfigured`.

# Errors
`Configuration` for a renounced owner, invalid name, zero ID or an already-set name or ID.
function_v0.name: set_chain_map

event_v0.doc: The owner set an immutable chain map.
event_v0.name: ChainMapConfigured

function_v0.doc:
Remove the owner permanently, freezing the set of chain maps.

The current owner authorizes. Emits `OwnershipTransferred` with no new owner.
Returns `Configuration` once ownership has been renounced.
function_v0.name: renounce_ownership

function_v0.doc:
Transfer mapping ownership to `new_owner` in one step, as OpenZeppelin `Ownable`.

The current owner authorizes. Emits `OwnershipTransferred`. Returns
`Configuration` once ownership has been renounced.
function_v0.name: transfer_ownership

function_v0.doc:
Require every concatenated 128-byte proof tuple to exist; empty input succeeds.

Each tuple is `chain[32] || oracle[32] || application[32] || hash[32]`.
Permissionless; preserves proof TTL and maintains instance/code TTL. Returns
`Malformed` for a partial tuple or `NotProven` for any missing or expired member;
the entire invocation fails if any check fails.
function_v0.name: efficient_require_proven
